_readme: Endpoints exempt from a tuned rate limit, each with the reason. `npm run check:rate-limits` fails when an anon-callable RPC or an Edge Function is neither limited nor listed here. Prefer adding a rule to app_private.request_rate_rules. Note: PostgREST runs POST on a STABLE or IMMUTABLE function read-only, where the counter cannot be written, so only VOLATILE functions are ever counted (the shared * default included).
